flags.message: Predictors were provisioned application.txt with empty_text: true (scanned PDF, no text layer), but the evaluator record now carries OCR'd text (ocr_derived: true). This is not a scoring issue. Re-OCR'ing pro se scanned applications before the predict fan-out would let predictors read the relief sought (here: a stay of a writ of possession pending an Eleventh Circuit stay motion).
